properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Twetikke-omusaalaba gwo
N'obwesigwa bwonna;
-Amazima gobunenga
Mu mawanga gonna.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tuwe twegenderezenga
Tube balongoofu;
-Essaddaaka-ey'obuntu bwaffe
Esiimibwe gy'oli.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Tuwe okwesiganga ggwe,
-Omulamuzi waffe;
-Ensonyi n'entiisa bireme
Kutukwata fenna.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Tuwe-okusonyiwagana
N'okwagala bonna;
Tube n'essanyu lingi nnyo
Eriva eri ggwe.
